title: ParserConfig
description: The configuration for the parser. It determines how the server parses the messages.

version.description: Immutable. Determines the version of both the default parser to be used when `schema` is not given, as well as the schematized parser used when `schema` is specified. This field is immutable after HL7v2 store creation.

allowNullHeader.description: Optional. Determines whether messages with no header are allowed.

segmentTerminator.description: Optional. Byte(s) to use as the segment terminator. If this is unset, '\r' is used as segment terminator, matching the HL7 version 2 specification.
